shorts.hook: Fifty-five fossil flies had a wasp hiding inside.
shorts.title: Wasps Ate These Flies Alive and Fossilized Inside Them
shorts.outro: Then Doug dressed as one. The full video is linked below.
shorts.description: X-ray scans of 1,510 fossil fly pupae found 55 with no fly left inside, just the parasitoid wasp that ate it from within, one species named after Alien's xenomorph.

shorts.hook: This fossil snake ate a lizard that ate an insect.
shorts.title: This Fossil Snake Ate a Lizard That Ate an Insect
shorts.outro: The fossils only get scarier from here. The full dig is linked below.
shorts.description: A detailed X-ray scan of a fossil snake revealed a lizard in its gut with an insect inside the lizard, a food chain stacked three levels deep.

shorts.title: This Fossil Fish Bit a Pterosaur and Couldn't Let Go
shorts.outro: Then Doug went fishing. The full video is linked below.
shorts.description: A big fish bit a fishing pterosaur's wing, got its teeth stuck in the skin, and both sank to the lagoon floor and died together, still locked in place.
